depth_reference: interior water depth above ground-floor slab

assumptions.text: Contents damage rises with water above each item's lowest vulnerable point: fraction = (depth - lowest point) / critical height, capped at 1. Critical height is set per value class and never exceeds the item's own height measured from the 3D scan. Low end: lowest point at the top of its range and the class's low value; high end: lowest point at the bottom of its range and the high value.
assumptions.source: Waterline method; totals sanity-checked against FEMA Hazus 6.1 contents curves (USACE Galveston, COM2/IND2)
